source: Per-commander triage of every unimplemented top-commanders.txt entry (AI agents reading Oracle text + rulings against the engine), normalized onto one feature vocabulary. See neededCards-features.md, 'The commander gap'.

bug:as-enters-choices-any-entry.description: Make chooseOnEnter and copyOnEnter real as-enters replacements, applied on every entry (reanimate, flicker, token copy) and before the enters-the-battlefield event, so ETB triggers see the copied or chosen permanent.

bug:cda-all-zones.description: A power-only CDA over a fixed printed toughness: setBasePtFromCount always sets toughness to the count plus an offset, so Eluge's '*/5, power equal to the number of Islands you control' and Mendicant Core's power-only count can't be expressed. Built so far: the CDA works in every zone (rule 604.3), counts cards in your hand, and counts any CardFilter over the battlefield (token stacks counted in full, with a re-entrancy guard for a self-referential filter) or over all graveyards.

bug:color-identity-back-face.description: colorIdentityOf should scan every face of a multi-face card, not just the definition it's given (the front). Deck validation and the card replacer both call it with the front face.

bug:commander-903-9a-current-rules.description: Model current rule 903.9a: a commander goes to the graveyard or exile, dies triggers and sacrifice events fire, and then its owner may move it to the command zone as a state-based action. This replaces the pre-move replacement effect. (The edict path's missing permanent-sacrificed event, once listed here, is fixed: every sacrifice path announces it.)

bug:commander-eligibility-vehicles.description: Deck validation admits a legendary Vehicle or Spacecraft with printed power and toughness as a commander (current Commander rules), not only legendary creatures and planeswalkers.

bug:control-effect-timestamps.description: Layer-2 control effects apply in timestamp order. Today a control-granting Aura always beats controlledByEffect, which carries no timestamp.

bug:counter-annihilation.description: The state-based action for rule 704.5q: +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters on the same permanent are removed in pairs.

bug:double-strike-between-damage-steps.description: Record which combatants had first strike or double strike when the first-strike damage step began. Losing or gaining first strike between the two steps then follows rule 510.4.

bug:lki-leaves-battlefield-triggers.description: Take a last-known snapshot of a permanent's computed types, subtypes, counters, keywords, lost abilities and granted dies triggers before moveObject clears it, and match leaves/dies trigger filters and granted dies triggers against that (rule 603.10a). Built: moveObject snapshots the leaving permanent (GameObject.lastKnown, a LastKnownInfo) — the victims of one simultaneous event all before the first moves — and a leaves/dies trigger matches its filter (FilterContext.lastKnown), 'you control', lost abilities, a copied card's own abilities and its granted triggers against that.

bug:lki-object-reads.description: When a resolving ability reads an object that has left the battlefield, it uses last-known information (rule 608.2h). This covers powerOf/toughnessOf of the source, trigger object or target, 'that creature's controller', and the source's keywords (lifelink) for damage it dealt. It includes tokens that were deleted. Built: powerOf/toughnessOf/manaValueOf/manaSpentOf/controllerOf, trigger-object and target conditions and a departed source's damage (colours, lifelink, deathtouch, controller) read the snapshot, picked by the battlefield stint the reference names (LastKnownRefs); a deleted token's is kept in GameState.ceasedTokens.

bug:lore-counters-fire-chapters.description: Lore counters added by an effect or by proliferate trigger the Saga's chapter abilities (rule 714.2c). Today only the chapter step and entering add them through addLoreCounter.

bug:mana-any-one-color.description: 'Add N mana of any one colour' is auto-paid as N independently coloured units (a Gilded Lotus pays {G}{W}). Emit one fixed option per colour instead.

bug:modal-modes-on-cast.description: Non-targeted modal spells choose their modes on cast (rule 700.2a), not at resolution, so anything that reads the spell on the stack sees them.

bug:player-leaves-game-cleanup.description: Rule 800.4a: when a player leaves the game, control effects they held end, stolen permanents (commanders included) return to their previous controllers, and their objects leave.

bug:saga-completion-sacrifice.description: A completed Saga is sacrificed (rule 714.4), so the SBA should emit permanent-sacrificed and sacrifice triggers should see it.

bug:sequence-suspends-on-decision.description: A sequence suspends when a step raises a decision (discard, sacrifice, look-and-choose) and resumes with the later steps after the answer. Today the later steps (draws) resolve before the player chooses.

bug:simultaneous-damage-batching.description: Simultaneous damage from several sources counts as one event where the rules say so: an enrage-style dealt-damage trigger fires once per batch. Built so far: lifelink gains once per source rather than once per recipient (combat damage, damage-all, damage to each player).

bug:simultaneous-zone-moves.description: Moves of several targets from one instruction ('destroy two target creatures', 'return X and Y') still happen one after another, and replacement effects don't look back at the group. Built so far: mass destruction, one sweep of state-based graveyard moves (lethal damage, 0 loyalty, unattached Auras, the legend rule, finished Sagas), edicts once every player has chosen, and overloaded or 'return all' bounces each move as one leave batch whose members see each other leave (rule 603.10a, withLeaveBatch), with commanders deferred by 903.9a still counted in their batch. Entering together is the same gap: permanents put onto the battlefield by one instruction enter one at a time, so a 'whenever another creature enters' ability among them misses the ones that entered before it (the Elas il-Kor ruling).

bug:static-scope-computed-keywords.description: AffectSpec.withKeyword reads computed layer-6 keywords (flying from an Aura, Equipment or grant-keyword) for a layer-7 P/T grant, not printed keywords.

bug:static-scope-computed-types.description: staticAffects' creature scopes (creatures-you-control, all-creatures, emblems, land creatures) gate on printed types through isPrintedCreature. They should read computed layer-4 types, so animated lands and crewed Vehicles get anthems and keyword grants.

bug:token-stack-fixes.description: Token-stack fixes: a stacked token whose static counts 'each other [type]' skips only itself, not its whole stack. Built so far: a sacrifice, tap or convoke cost can use part of a stack, and a stacked token targeted by a multi-step effect (Tamiyo's Safekeeping, Act of Treason, Blossoming Defense) is split off once, at target choice, so every step hits the same token.

bug:transform-fixes.description: Transform fixes: a permanent entering transformed applies its back face's enters replacements, and a delayed trigger transforms a permanent only if it hasn't transformed since (rule 701.28f).

bug:x-value-propagation.description: X carries through: an ETB trigger that refers to X uses the X its source was cast with (rule 107.3m). Built so far: a spell's mana value on the stack includes its chosen X (rule 202.3e) in manaValueOfTarget and filters, and a target that was a spell is read with it after leaving the stack (Mana Drain).

bug:zone-change-object-identity.description: Rule 400.7: an object that changes zones becomes a new object. Delayed triggers, 'return it' effects, trigger-object references, targets in a graveyard, and battlefield-source identity still follow a card that left and came back; put-onto-battlefield still relies on the card being in its expected zone, and an 'until the source leaves' exile does nothing if the source has already left (rule 610.3c). Built so far: GameObject.zoneChangeCount (bumped by every moveObject) and sourceZoneChangeCount on an activated ability whose source stays in the command zone or graveyard (staysInZone), so its 'source' names nothing once the card has changed zones (Derevi, Reassembling Skeleton); a flicker source is tracked by timestamp on the battlefield. Last-known information names the battlefield stint a reference means (LastKnownRefs, by zoneChangeCount), so a dies trigger still reads the creature it was about after the card came back; but a card that left, came back and left again before that ability resolved keeps only its later snapshot.

condition:cast-spell-targets.description: A cast-spell trigger clause or condition on the spell's chosen targets: it targets a creature you control, it targets only this permanent, it targets a single creature, it still has a legal permanent or player target.

condition:count-excluding-source.description: 'Other' / 'each other' everywhere: excludeSelf on countOf amounts and on the controls condition (also excluding a target), and exceptSource on add-counter-all and grant-keyword-all.

condition:defending-player-life-rank.description: Attack-trigger conditions on how the defending player's life compares with the other opponents: dethrone (most life or tied, players only) and 'not the lowest life'.

condition:devotion.description: A devotion StaticCondition, including devotion to two colours with a hybrid pip counted once.

condition:entry-provenance.description: Record how and from where a permanent entered, and let conditions and triggers read it: 'if it was cast' (from any zone, command zone included), 'enters from exile' or 'came from a graveyard', and 'not put onto the battlefield by this ability'.

condition:filter-attachments.description: CardFilter clauses about attachments: equipped, enchanted, enchanted by an Aura you control, and modified (has a counter, is equipped, or is enchanted by an Aura you control). Also a 'source is equipped' condition. Used by attack, combat-damage and cast triggers.

condition:filter-card-property-clauses.description: Small CardFilter clauses about a card's own properties: two or more card types, has or lacks abilities, base P/T (after layer 7b), {X} in its mana cost, the number of coloured mana symbols, has a mana ability (granted ones included, also as an AffectSpec narrowing), and a name different from every [filter] you control.

condition:filter-combinators.description: CardFilter boolean combinators: anyOf (historic, 'artifact or Artificer', 'black and/or red', 'flash or haste', 'MV or power equal to N') and negated clauses (notSupertype for 'nonlegendary' and 'nonbasic', notName).

condition:filter-dynamic-compare.description: NumCompare.n reads an EffectAmount when evaluated: the sacrificed MV + 1 (no 'N plus an amount' EffectAmount exists yet — Eddie Brock, Iron Man; they also need effect:sacrificed-object-lki). Built so far: a filter comparison's number can be a live EffectAmount (DynamicOperand — the trigger object's mana value or power, the source's current power, the trigger value), re-evaluated at resolution, with a departed trigger object read by last-known mana value (Clement, the Worrywort).

condition:filter-this-turn-history.description: CardFilter clauses on an object's history this turn: enteredThisTurn (from enteredBattlefieldOnTurn) and attackedThisTurn. attackedThisTurn also has to be cleared on a zone change, since it goes stale today.

condition:player-state-thresholds.description: Numeric StaticConditions on the rest of player and game state: N or more life, at most half your starting life, N or more cards in exile. Built so far: 'N or more cards in hand' and 'you are the monarch'.

condition:source-state.description: Intervening-if conditions on the ability's source, checked when it triggers and again on resolution: it's still on the battlefield (the same object), or it's in the command zone or on the battlefield (eminence). Built so far: the source condition ({ kind: 'source', filter }), which covers 'it's attacking' and 'it's tapped'.

condition:top-card-of-library.description: A condition on the top card of a library (revealed to every player) that a conditional can branch on: 'reveal the top card; if it's a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, otherwise draw a card', where the else branch is a real draw.

condition:turn-structure.description: Conditions on where the turn is: the current step or phase ('only during combat', 'during your end step'). A per-turn count of combat and main phases backs 'the first combat phase this turn' and 'your second main phase', which is only the first postcombat main.

cost:ability-cost-modification.description: A static that changes the activation cost of other permanents' activated abilities matching a filter ('Activated abilities of Foods you control cost {1} less to activate'), read in the activation cost path and in legalActions' affordability.

cost:choose-cards-as-cost.description: Activation costs paid with cards the player chooses: discard N cards, or exile N [filter] cards from your graveyard.

cost:colorless-hybrid-mana.description: Colourless-hybrid mana symbols ({C/W} and the like): parsing, mana value, colour, and payment in planManaPayment.

cost:commander-tax-as-life.description: A CardDefinition field that turns commander tax into life (2 life per earlier cast) instead of {2} generic mana.

cost:cost-modification-extensions.description: Cost modifications that depend on more than a count: only the first matching spell each turn, the chosen targets, removing a coloured pip, reducing the generic half of a twobrid pip. Built so far: a reduction that scales with a general amount (counters on the source, a filtered count, graveyard size).

cost:mana-ability-complex-costs.description: Mana abilities whose cost is more than {T}: a coloured-mana cost, removing counters, sacrificing a filtered permanent, or tapping other permanents. They stay mana abilities (no stack), and the auto-payer can use them or knowingly skip them.

cost:mana-spending-rules.description: Rules for what mana may pay for: 'spend mana as though it were mana of any colour/type' for particular spells (in the planner and spendFromPool), and deny-list restrictions ('can't be spent to cast nonartifact spells').

cost:may-cost-non-mana.description: The may effect's optional cost supports energy, life plus mana, and a variable energy amount, and is offered only when fully payable.

cost:pay-life-for-pips.description: A static that lets its controller pay 2 life instead of each {B} (or other coloured) pip in any cost (K'rrik), threaded through Game.payMana/planPayment. The player's choice between life and mana is decision:manual-payment-choices.

cost:remove-counters-from-chosen.description: A removeCounter cost paid from a chosen permanent other than the source, or N counters spread across several creatures you control, carried on the activate-ability action.

cost:sacrifice-multiple.description: Sacrifice N permanents, or any number of them, as a cost with a filter and a chosen set. Covers 'sacrifice six Blood tokens' and 'you may sacrifice any number of creatures; each reduces the cost by {2}'.

cost:unattach-equipment.description: An 'Unattach an Equipment from this' activation cost (rule 701.3d): the player chooses which attached Equipment, the cost is unpayable with none attached, and the effect can read that Equipment's mana value.

decision:choose-from-zone-extensions.description: Extensions to choose-from-zone: pick across several zones at once (hand or graveyard, all graveyards), apply constraints to the whole selection (different names, four or more card types among them), and let a chooser other than the zone's owner pick ('an opponent chooses a card from your hand').

decision:choose-number.description: A resolution-time choice of a number in a range ('put up to three lore counters on it').

decision:choose-permanent.description: An untargeted resolution-time choice of one or more permanents matching a filter, made by a named player: populate's token, amass's Army, 'put counters on a creature you control', 'exile any number of other nonland permanents you control', and one of a spell's targets to copy.

decision:choose-player.description: An untargeted 'choose a player' or 'choose an opponent', at resolution or as the permanent enters (several choices must differ), plus a 'chosen player' PlayerScope that draw, counters and create-token can route to.

decision:choose-tap-costs.description: The player chooses which permanents pay a tap-others cost, including 'tap any number with total power N or more' and 'tap X untapped permanents' with X chosen. Built so far: a fixed-count tap cost (an ability's tapOthers, Sephara's alternative cost) is the player's choice, a token stack can pay part of itself, and the permanents tapped can't also pay the cost's mana.

decision:copy-new-targets.description: 'You may choose new targets for the copy': raise choose-targets for each copy (storm, Twincast, copy triggers), with the original's targets as the default.

decision:discard-any-number.description: Discard any number of cards (0 up to hand size, optionally filtered) as a real discard, including an as-enters discard that decides the counters the permanent enters with.

decision:free-cast-choices.description: castCardWithoutPaying (cascade, suspend) gets the full cast. The 'you may' can be declined, targets are chosen rather than set to the first option, and modes, the MDFC face, kicker and mandatory additional costs are all offered. Cost increases still apply.

decision:legend-rule-choice.description: The legend rule asks the controller which same-named legendary permanent to keep, instead of always keeping the oldest.

decision:library-ordering.description: The player orders cards they put on top or bottom of the library: scry's kept cards, and 'the rest on the bottom in any order'.

decision:manual-payment-choices.description: Let the payer steer mana payment: pay from sources rather than floating mana, and choose mana or 2 life for each Phyrexian pip, instead of the auto-payer deciding.

decision:variable-target-count.description: A target slot with a variable number of targets ('any number of target …', or 'up to X' with X from kicks or an amount), with optional constraints across the whole set ('total power 10 or less'). This touches TargetSpec, legalActions' per-slot options, the choose-targets validator and the client picker.

decision:ward-payment.description: Ward as a real triggered ability when the object becomes a target. The targeting player chooses whether to pay, and a non-mana ward cost (discard a card) needs its own choice.

effect:add-mana-extensions.description: Extensions to add-mana: the player chooses the colour split when mana is added outside cost payment, exactly one of each of several colours ({B}{R}{G}), colours taken from a referenced card, and 'each player adds'.

effect:add-subtype.description: A one-shot layer-4 type or subtype addition to targets or returned objects, for a duration or permanently, without touching P/T.

effect:additional-combat-after-this-phas.description: An additional combat phase that follows this combat directly, with or without an extra main phase, rather than looping back after postcombat main.

effect:additional-upkeep-steps.description: 'You get that many additional upkeep steps after this phase': extra beginning phases (untap and draw skipped) inserted after the current combat, with upkeep triggers firing in each (rules 500.8 and 500.10).

effect:amount-aggregate.description: Aggregates in CDAs (a layer-7b base P/T set from a sum or max, e.g. Karn, Legacy Reforged) and in static P/T bonuses, a greatest value over an attack batch or any non-battlefield set, and a static ability's aggregate condition that counts its own source. Built so far: sum and max of power, toughness or mana value over filtered battlefield permanents (a token stack counts N times in a sum; 0 over nothing) as an EffectAmount, as the StaticConditions aggregate and source-greatest ('greater than each other creature's power', strict or not), and as a cost reduction (Ghalta's shape).

effect:amount-counters-on-object.description: An EffectAmount for the counters on an object (all kinds, or one kind) on the source, trigger object or a target. It falls back to last-known counters once the object has left. Also an intervening-if for 'if it had counters on it'.

effect:amount-fields-dynamic.description: Let fixed-number fields take an EffectAmount evaluated at resolution or entry: scry N, look-and-choose max, modal maxModes, animate's P/T, an X/X token's base P/T (layer 7b), and the enters-with-counters amount (a live count, or another card's power).

effect:amount-new-variants.description: Small new EffectAmounts: differences floored at 0 (defending hand size minus yours, the larger of power and toughness minus the smaller), the number of colours of a referenced object, and the distinct card types among cards in your graveyard or all graveyards (also as a CDA count).

effect:amount-turn-stat.description: EffectAmounts that read turn stats: your life lost, gained or cards drawn this turn, the total across opponents, and the number of players or opponents who lost life this turn.

effect:attach-extensions.description: Aura and Equipment attachment beyond 'attach the source': an Aura put onto the battlefield without being cast attaches to a chosen or named legal object (rule 303.4f), including Aura tokens and token copies of a creature's attachments. Also attach chosen Equipment or Auras (any number) to a creature, and check legality (the enchant restriction, Equipment only on creatures).

effect:become-copy.description: Existing permanents matching a filter become copies of an object (a layer-1 copyOf override) for a duration, or permanently.

effect:cast-and-activate-restrictions.description: Casting and activation rules checked in whyCannotCast, whyCannotActivate and legalActions: prohibitions (a player can't cast or activate this turn, a permanent's abilities can't be activated, opponents can't cast spells or can't during your turn, you can't cast permanent spells, split second), 'cast spells as though they had flash', and a card's own castOnlyIf restriction from any zone.

effect:cast-during-resolution.description: Casting during resolution: cast a chosen matching card from hand, from the top X of the library, or the card just exiled, without paying its mana cost or for an alternative cost such as discarding a card. Also copy a card and cast the copy for free.

effect:choices-by-other-players.description: Choices that belong to players other than the controller, in APNAP order: a 'may' answered by the active player or the entering creature's controller, 'each player may', tempting offer, villainous choice, and 'unless' punishers. The punishers can be asked of each opponent in turn, can have the controller as chooser, and can offer 'or discard a card'.

effect:control-change-extensions.description: Control changes beyond 'you gain control of target': give control to another player (donate, the active player, put a card onto the battlefield under a target player's control), mass filter-driven gain control, and rotating control around the table.

effect:copy-ability.description: Copy an activated or triggered ability on the stack, keeping its X value.

effect:copy-exceptions.description: Copy effects with exceptions, stored as copiable values (rule 707.9b): add or override card types, subtypes and colours, set base P/T, grant abilities, and 'except it has this card's other abilities' (Sakashima). Copies of those copies inherit the exceptions.

effect:copy-permanent-spell.description: Copy a permanent spell. The copy resolves into a token (rule 707.10f), keeping X.

effect:copy-spell-extensions.description: Extensions to copy-spell: copy the triggering spell (not only a target), still copy it from last-known information after it leaves the stack, keep the original's cast choices (modes, kicked, overload), and retarget as the effect says (one copy per other legal target, or target the source instead).

effect:create-token-with-counters.description: create-token puts N counters of a kind on each token actually created (a 0/0 Hydra with X +1/+1 counters), with N read from an amount and such tokens never stack-compacted.

effect:created-tokens-gain-keyword-eot.description: Tokens an effect just created gain a keyword (haste) until end of turn. create-token has no such option, and create-token-copy's gainsHaste is permanent.

effect:delayed-trigger-extensions.description: Delayed triggers keyed to an event rather than a step beyond one permanent leaving ('whenever it deals combat damage this turn', 'when you next cast a creature spell this turn'), and delayed triggers that capture the trigger object or the tokens just created. Built so far: a delayed trigger keyed to one permanent leaving the battlefield for given zones (dies, is exiled), optionally only this turn, whose trigger object is that permanent (Kelsien, the Plague; earthbend's return).

effect:divide-among-targets.description: Divide or distribute an amount (damage or counters) among the chosen targets, at least one each. The split is announced as the spell or ability goes on the stack (rule 601.2d).

effect:double-counters-each-kind.description: Double every kind of counter on one object (the trigger object), not one kind across a filter.

effect:duration-extensions.description: New modifier durations: 'until your next turn', and 'for as long as it has a [kind] counter on it' for P/T and type grants.

effect:emblem-triggered-abilities.description: Emblems that carry triggered abilities: create-emblem takes a TriggeredAbility, detectTriggers scans emblems, and a sourceless emblem trigger can choose targets.

effect:end-the-turn.description: End the turn (rule 723.1): exile everything on the stack, remove creatures from combat and go to cleanup. Cleanup gets priority when something triggers there, followed by another cleanup (rule 514.3a).

effect:enter-attacking.description: Put a card or create tokens (copies included) onto the battlefield tapped and attacking. Its controller chooses which player or planeswalker it attacks (rule 508.4).

effect:exchange-text-boxes.description: Exchange two permanents' text boxes: a layer-3 per-object 'rules text comes from X' redirect that every ability, keyword, static and text read honours.

effect:exile-library-all-but-bottom.description: Exile all but the bottom card of target player's library.

effect:exile-with-counters.description: The exile effect accepts the trigger object (a card in a graveyard, only if it's still there, with 'if you do' gated on it), and named counters (croak, kick, fetch, stash) go on cards in exile, including cards an effect just exiled.

effect:flicker-generalized.description: Flicker the ability's own source, flicker several targets at once and return them together, and link a delayed return to the exile.

effect:impulse-exile-other-libraries.description: Exile the top card of other players' libraries (a target player, the damaged player, each opponent, each player), face down where required. The play permission goes to the controller, or each player plays their own card.

effect:look-and-choose-leftover.description: More look-and-choose leftover destinations: into the graveyard, or a destination decided by a condition checked after the chosen card is placed.

effect:look-and-choose-second-pick.description: A second choice stage over the looked-at cards left after the first pick ('you may put one into your hand, then put any number of land cards from among them onto the battlefield tapped and the rest into your graveyard').

effect:lose-game.description: A 'target player loses the game' effect routed through the existing elimination path.

effect:mana-ability-dynamic-amount.description: Choosing an arbitrary colour split by hand for a very large X (past 22 for two colours only all-of-one-type is offered; needs a client count picker), letting the player pick the colour of leftover floating mana when the auto-payer draws on such a source, and 'X mana of any one color' with a live X (a live any-color amount is planned as a free mix). Built so far: live-amount mana abilities (power, counts, devotion, turn stats) sized by manaSources/standaloneManaChoices through a resolution context; one compressed anyColorOf payer option for 'X in any combination of'; untapped once-a-turn {0} mana abilities as auto-payer sources, with the once-a-turn use recorded when a payment draws on them (Vivi Ornitier, Marwyn, Kydele).

effect:mana-ability-side-effects.description: Mana abilities with non-mana side effects that still never use the stack: a rider effect (a delayed trigger or counter) on the ability itself, and triggered mana abilities ('whenever you tap [a permanent] for mana', rule 605.1b). The auto-payer accounts for both.

effect:may-sacrifice-then.description: 'You may sacrifice [N] [filter]. If you do, [effect]': offered only when enough matching permanents exist, the player chooses which (or declines), and the tail runs only after the sacrifice has actually happened. Also the mandatory form, 'Sacrifice a creature. When you do, [effect]' (Minsc & Boo's −2): the same choice without the decline. Either way the tail reads the permanent chosen through effect:sacrificed-object-lki's "sacrificed" ref, which the sacrifice step has to bind — today the sacrifice effect only queues its decision, so a step after it runs before anything is sacrificed.

effect:missing-tokens.description: Blood tokens (Shilgengar, Strefan), whatever else Chatterfang's and Jaws' triggers need, and a distinct 'whenever you investigate' event (investigate is plain Clue creation today, so nothing can trigger on it). Built so far: the Clue token and an investigate() helper (Tivit, Wernog, Morska), and the 1/1 black-green Insect (Grist); Treasure and the 1/1 green Squirrel already existed.

effect:modal-ability-targeted-modes.description: Modal triggered and activated abilities whose modes carry their own targets, with modes chosen as the ability goes on the stack (rule 700.2), the way castModal works for spells.

effect:modifier-grants-activated.description: A one-shot PtModifier can grant activated abilities, a mana ability included, which manaSources, legalActions and activateAbility then see.

effect:move-counter.description: Move a counter from one object to another (a removal, then a put-onto). When the source has several counter kinds, the player chooses which one.

effect:player-scope-extensions.description: More player scopes: players named by the triggering event (defending player, damaged player, active player, the trigger object's controller, each opponent other than that player), each player or each opponent for mill, discard and create-token, CardFilter controlledBy active player, and per-player amounts (each opponent loses half their life).

effect:put-commanders-onto-battlefield.description: Put all commanders from the command zone onto the battlefield under your control, whoever owns them.

effect:put-onto-battlefield-options.description: Options on putting a card onto the battlefield: transformed (face 1), from flicker, exile or a graveyard, and return-from-graveyard's withCounters (a finality counter, for example).

effect:random-choice.description: Seeded random choices at resolution: a random opponent bound into a slot, or a random matching card from your graveyard.

effect:reflexive-trigger.description: Real reflexive triggers (rule 603.12): after an optional payment or action ('when you do'), a new triggered ability goes on the stack and chooses its targets and modes then.

effect:regenerate.description: Regeneration (rule 701.15): a turn-scoped shield that replaces destruction by tapping the permanent, removing it from combat and removing damage.

effect:repeat-process.description: Loop an effect block while a condition on the card just moved holds ('if it's a land, repeat this process'), stopping when the library or graveyard runs out.

effect:return-to-hand-extensions.description: return-to-hand from non-battlefield zones (a graveyard card, the source, the trigger object, now or on a delayed trigger), and returning a spell from the stack to its owner's hand (not a counter).

effect:reveal-until.description: A generalised cascade loop: reveal or exile cards from the top of a target player's library until one matches a filter (or a dynamic MV bound). The hit goes to a destination or a follow-up, and the rest are exiled, put on the bottom in random order, or kept exiled.

effect:sacrificed-object-lki.description: Snapshot the permanent sacrificed to pay a cost, or by a preceding step, and expose its last-known power, mana value, types, subtypes and isCommander. These feed amounts (the Fling family), conditions ('if it was a commander' or 'a Hamster') and dynamic filters ('shares a card type with it'). Built for a sacrifice paid as a cost (activated ability or spell) and a sacrifice-source step: the AmountRef "sacrificed" (powerOf/toughnessOf/manaValueOf), the "sacrificed" StaticCondition and CardFilter.sharesCardTypeWith. A sacrifice *chosen* by an earlier step, optional ("you may sacrifice …; when you do") or not (Minsc & Boo's "Sacrifice a creature. When you do"), is effect:may-sacrifice-then's.

effect:shuffle-library.description: A standalone 'shuffle your library' effect step ('Shuffle your library, then exile the top card').

effect:target-other-than-source.description: An 'another / other target' exclusion for triggered as well as activated abilities: drop the source (or an earlier slot's pick, or the triggering player) from a slot's options. Split it from the 'sacrifice another' cost flag, which otherOnly controls too today.

effect:target-spec-additions.description: New TargetSpecs: 'target opponent whose turn it is', and spells restricted by controller ('target instant or sorcery spell you control').

effect:temporary-player-effect.description: A resolving effect installs a player-level continuous effect with a duration (end of turn, or until your next turn), like an emblem that expires: a cost reduction for matching spells, a replacement effect, or 'cast spells from your hand without paying their mana costs this turn'.

effect:this-way-results.description: The resolution context records what earlier steps actually did beyond discards, draws, mills and sacrifices: cards exiled or moved this way ('for each creature exiled this way', 'put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand' — choosing or copying among the cards just moved), and whether an optional action like putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield happened ('if you don't'). Built so far: the thisWay amount and this-way condition over cards discarded, drawn, milled or sacrificed by the resolution so far (who, filter, card types among them), read off its events since GameState.resolutionSince (Kefka, Court Mage; Lord Windgrace; Mr. Foxglove).

effect:token-copy-last-known-info.description: create-token-copy of an object that has left the battlefield (a dead creature, a dying Clone) uses its last-known copiable values, including copyOf and face. Today it reads the object in its new zone, or nothing if it was deleted.

effect:token-copy-options.description: create-token-copy options: 'tapped', as create-token has, and one copy for each object in the triggering batch ('for each of them, create a token that's a copy of it'), token stacks included.

keyword:airbend.description: Airbend: exile the permanent or spell, and its owner may cast it from exile for {2}.

keyword:annihilator.description: Annihilator N (rule 702.86): a parameterised, grantable keyword with an attack trigger that makes the defending player sacrifice N permanents.

keyword:blight.description: Blight N: a player chooses a creature they control and puts N -1/-1 counters on it, as an effect ('each opponent blights 1', queued per player like pendingSacrifices) and as a cost (Ward-Blight). A player with no creature can't blight.

keyword:blitz.description: Blitz: an alternative-cost cast variant; a blitzed permanent has haste and 'when this dies, draw a card', and is sacrificed at the next end step. Includes a static granting blitz to matching creature spells.

keyword:bloodthirst.description: Bloodthirst: enter with counters if an opponent was dealt damage this turn, with the amount read from a stat.

keyword:casualty.description: Casualty N (rule 702.153): an optional additional cost to sacrifice a creature with power N or greater, offered as a cast variant. If it was paid, a cast trigger copies the spell.

keyword:changeling.description: 'Is every creature type' (changeling) and 'every land type': a marker that matches every type of that kind, in every zone, for filters, lords and effectiveSubtypes.

keyword:connive.description: Connive N (rule 701.50): draw N, discard N, then put a +1/+1 counter on the creature for each nonland card discarded.

keyword:crew.description: Vehicles and crew N: tap any number of untapped creatures with total power N or more (a chosen cost) to make the Vehicle an artifact creature until end of turn.

keyword:decayed.description: Decayed (rule 702.147): can't block, and when it attacks, sacrifice it at end of combat (an end-of-combat delayed trigger). As a real keyword, 'if it didn't have decayed' can check it.

keyword:delve.description: Delve: while casting, exile any number of cards from your graveyard to pay generic mana.

keyword:devoid.description: Devoid (rule 702.114): a colour-setting characteristic that makes the object colourless in every zone (layer 5).

keyword:discover.description: Discover N (rule 701.57): exile from the top until a nonland card with MV N or less, then cast it free or put it into your hand. The rest go to the bottom in random order.

keyword:dredge.description: Dredge N (rule 702.52): an optional per-draw replacement (mill N and return this card instead of drawing) when the library holds at least N cards. Every draw site, including multi-card draws, has to pause for the choice and resume.

keyword:earthbend.description: Earthbend N: target land you control becomes a 0/0 haste creature that's still a land and gets N +1/+1 counters, with the return clause when it dies or is exiled.

keyword:evoke.description: Evoke (rule 702.74): an alternative cost offered as a cast variant, plus the 'when it enters, if it was evoked, sacrifice it' trigger. Granting evoke to other spells is static:grant-to-cards-outside-battlefield.

keyword:exhaust.description: Exhaust: an activated ability that can be activated only once while the object exists.

keyword:explore.description: Explore (rule 701.44): reveal the top card; a land goes to hand, otherwise put a +1/+1 counter on the explorer and its controller chooses to keep the card on top or put it into the graveyard. Emits an explores event. 'Each [creature] explores' lets the controller choose the order.

keyword:firebending.description: Firebending N: an attack trigger that adds N {R}, and the mana lasts until end of combat.

keyword:freerunning.description: Freerunning (rule 702.173): a per-player turn flag set when an Assassin or a commander deals combat damage to a player, and an alternative cost offered as a cast variant while it's set.

keyword:landwalk.description: Landwalk (rule 702.14): can't be blocked while the defending player controls a land of that type.

keyword:manifest-dread.description: Manifest dread (rule 701.62): look at the top two cards, put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 and the other into the graveyard. Needs mechanic:face-down.

keyword:mayhem.description: Mayhem: a per-card 'discarded this turn' marker plus a graveyard cast permission for the mayhem cost, gated on that marker.

keyword:melee.description: Melee: when this attacks, it gets +1/+1 for each opponent attacked this combat. Needs a count of distinct attacked opponents.

keyword:miracle.description: Miracle (rule 702.94): track the first card each player draws each turn, offer to reveal it, and let its controller cast it for the miracle cost.

keyword:mobilize.description: Mobilize N: when this attacks, create N tapped and attacking 1/1 red Warriors and sacrifice them at the next end step. Builds on effect:enter-attacking.

keyword:multikicker.description: Multikicker: a repeatable kicker whose number of payments is chosen at cast and read as an amount.

keyword:ninjutsu.description: Ninjutsu: an activated ability from hand once blockers are declared. Pay its cost and return an unblocked attacker you control, and the ninja enters tapped and attacking.

keyword:offspring.description: Offspring: an optional additional cost with a 'paid' bit carried onto the permanent, and the linked ETB 'if its offspring cost was paid, create a 1/1 token copy of it'. Includes a static that grants offspring to creature spells you cast.

keyword:saddle.description: Saddle N (rule 702.171): a sorcery-speed tap-creatures-with-total-power cost that marks the creature saddled until end of turn, and records which creatures saddled it this turn.

keyword:toxic.description: Toxic N (rule 702.164): a cumulative, parameterised keyword that gives poison counters on combat damage to a player. Needs mechanic:player-counters (poison).

keyword:warp.description: Warp (rule 702.185): an alternative cost from hand. At the next end step the permanent is exiled, and its owner may cast it from exile later.

keyword:waterbend.description: Waterbend: a cost-payment method that taps untapped artifacts and creatures you control to pay generic mana (like convoke or improvise), with the player choosing what to tap.

keyword:web-slinging.description: Web-slinging: an alternative cost that pays mana and returns a tapped creature you control to hand, with a choice of which creature.

mechanic:clash.description: Clash: both players reveal their top card and each chooses top or bottom for their own card, and there is a 'whenever you win a clash' trigger.

mechanic:coin-flip.description: Seeded coin flips: win and lose branches, 'flip until you lose', a log event, and a 'whenever a player wins a coin flip' trigger.

mechanic:commander-pairing.description: Deck validation for two commanders: both need Partner, 'Partner with [name]' pairs only with that card, Friends forever, Character select and Father & son pair only within their variant, and 'Choose a Background' pairs with a legendary Background enchantment. Built so far: plain Partner, which the deck validator checks (canPairCommanders) and which travels as a pair from the deck builder through the room server to the table.

mechanic:curses.description: Auras that enchant a player (Curses): attachedTo can hold a player, a 'target permanent or player' spec, an enchanted-player scope, returning a Curse attached to a player, and moving a Curse to a chosen opponent.

mechanic:dice-rolling.description: Dice rolling (rule 706) on the seeded Rng: a roll effect, a die-rolled event, and a 'whenever you roll N or higher' trigger that fires once per die.

mechanic:dungeon.description: Venture into the dungeon: the dungeon cards and their room abilities, branching choices, dungeon completion, and a 'whenever you complete a dungeon' trigger.

mechanic:face-down.description: Face-down permanents (rule 708): a characteristic-less 2/2, identity hidden per viewer, turning face up (special action, cost, triggers, 'you may turn a permanent face up'), 'enters face down' triggers, leaving play, and a noted card name on a face-down permanent (Magar). Shared by manifest, morph, disguise and cloak.

mechanic:goad-extensions.description: Goad beyond 'every creature a player controls': a target creature, creatures matching a filter, goad for the rest of the game, static goad while the source remains, and a CardFilter 'goaded' clause that reads last-known state on death.

mechanic:incubate.description: Double-faced tokens, and incubate N: an Incubator artifact token with N +1/+1 counters and '{2}: Transform', whose back face is a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature.

mechanic:keyword-counters.description: Keyword counters (rule 122.1b): flying, lifelink, vigilance and other counters grant that keyword in layer 6 while present.

mechanic:mdfc-transform.description: Per the 2025 rules change, a modal DFC whose other face has a permanent type can transform. isTransformingDfc and transformPermanent should allow it.

mechanic:mutate.description: Mutate (rule 702.140): an alternative cost targeting a non-Human creature you own, and merged permanents (the top card's characteristics plus every card's abilities), with mutate triggers.

mechanic:player-counters.description: Player counter kinds beyond energy: experience counters (a get effect, an EffectAmount, a P/T bonus that reads them) and poison counters (the 10-poison SBA loss, 'corrupted' conditions). Both need events, view and client display, and proliferate over players who have them.

mechanic:rad-counters.description: Rad counters: a player counter kind plus its inherent trigger at the beginning of that player's precombat main phase (mill that many; for each nonland card milled, lose 1 life and remove a rad counter). Builds on mechanic:player-counters.

mechanic:role-tokens.description: Role tokens: the Role subtype and the SBA that, when a player controls two or more Roles on the same permanent, puts all but the newest into the graveyard.

mechanic:rooms.description: Rooms (rule 709.5): split enchantments with two doors, each cast separately, a locked or unlocked state per door, and 'unlock a door' as a special action and as an effect.

mechanic:speed.description: Start your engines! (rule 702.179): PlayerState.speed starts at 1, rises at most once per turn when an opponent loses life, caps at 4, and max-speed abilities read it.

mechanic:station.description: Station (rule 702.184) and Spacecraft: a sorcery-speed ability that taps another creature you control and puts charge counters equal to its power, with station thresholds.

mechanic:suspect.description: Suspect (rule 701.60): a permanent designation that grants menace and 'can't block' until it leaves or is unsuspected.

mechanic:suspend-and-time-counters.description: Suspend and time-counter follow-ups: time travel (rule 701.56, choose add, remove or neither for each suspended card and time-counter permanent), granting suspend with N time counters, and a suspend cast that fires whenever the last time counter comes off.

mechanic:the-ring.description: The Ring tempts you (rule 701.52): the Ring emblem's four cumulative levels, choosing a Ring-bearer, the temptation count, a 'whenever the Ring tempts you' trigger, and protection from Ring-bearers.

mechanic:voting.description: Voting: each player votes for one named option in turn order, starting with the controller. Tally the votes, and let 'vote an additional time' statics add optional extra votes.

replacement:as-transforms.description: 'As this creature transforms into [face], ...' applied as part of the transform itself (replacement-timed), not as a respondable transforms trigger, and not when the permanent enters already transformed.

replacement:copy-on-enter-options.description: Widen copyOnEnter: a filter narrower than any creature ('another creature you control'), and entering as a copy of a card in exile or a graveyard.

replacement:damage-modification.description: Damage replacements beyond the global doubler: multipliers scoped by source or recipient, +N damage, and static prevention with a follow-up (prevent damage to opponents and mill that many, prevent damage to this permanent and add counters instead).

replacement:enters-modifier-via-permissi.description: A permanent played or cast through a granted permission enters tapped or with a counter (finality).

replacement:exile-instead.description: Exile-instead replacements: finality counters, 'if it would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else', and a dies-only form that doesn't catch discard or mill.

replacement:mana-pool-emptying.description: Hooks at the single pool-emptying site: unspent mana becomes another colour (or colourless) and stays, mana of a colour persists, and mana burn.

replacement:new-event-replacements.description: New ReplacementSpec event kinds: 'if you would draw a card, draw N instead' (conditional), a would-mill multiplier scoped to opponents, and life gain ('gain that much plus N', 'opponents can't gain life').

replacement:spell-exiled-as-it-resolves.description: A spell chosen by a trigger to be exiled as it resolves, with follow-up handling (Feather's return to hand). Built so far: a spell cast through a graveyard permission can be marked exile-instead-of-graveyard (castFromGraveyard.exileAfterwards, GameObject.exileIfWouldGoToGraveyard), which covers Kess, Dissident Mage's static.

replacement:token-creation-additive.description: An additive token replacement (rule 614.1a): 'those tokens plus that many [token] are created instead'. The extra tokens inherit the creating effect's riders (tapped, attacking, haste, end-step sacrifice) but not the original tokens' abilities, and the replacement doesn't apply to its own tokens.

stat:mana-spent-to-cast.description: Record whether any of the mana spent to cast a spell came from an artifact, as a cast-trigger condition. Built so far: the mana actually spent to cast it (0 for free casts), as the manaSpentOf amount and the manaSpent filter clause.

stat:milled-this-turn.description: A per-card marker for 'put into a graveyard from a library this turn'.

stat:object-damage-history.description: A per-object, turn-scoped record of damage: which sources damaged it (with last-known subtypes and controllers), whether it dealt damage to another creature this turn, and whether it was dealt excess damage (rule 120.4a). It backs 'dies after being dealt damage this turn by a [filter]' and 'is dealt excess damage'.

stat:per-ability-turn-counters.description: Per-object, per-ability counters that reset each turn. Built: 'this ability triggers only once each turn' (TriggeredAbility.oncePerTurn), 'do this only once each turn' (may.oncePerTurn), 'choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn' (modal.notChosenThisTurn) and 'if this is the Nth time this ability has resolved this turn' (the resolved-this-turn condition).

stat:spells-cast-this-turn-record.description: A per-player, per-turn record of each spell cast: its types, subtypes and mana value, with X included. It backs conditions such as 'you've cast an instant or sorcery this turn', 'a creature and a noncreature spell', 'three or more spells', and 'an {X} spell already this turn'.

stat:turn-event-tallies.description: Per-player, per-turn tallies: PlayerState.turnHistory — permanents entered under a player's control, creatures died under it (last-known), permanents sacrificed, permanents exiled from under it, permanent cards put into their graveyard (descend), damage and combat damage taken, raid, and the damage sources they controlled dealt with each source's colours as it dealt it — read by the turn-history and damage-dealt-this-turn conditions, the turnHistory and damageDealtThisTurn amounts and the damage-taken, combat-damage-taken and attacked turn stats (Tymna the Weaver, Éowyn, Shieldmaiden, Ojer Axonil's Temple of Power).

static:affect-scope-by-filter.description: Generalise AffectSpec beyond its fixed scopes to a CardFilter-driven scope: all permanents or artifacts you control, creatures you don't control or an opponent's, commanders you own, creatures you control but don't own, card-type and subtype any-of narrowing, counters on any permanent. wardOf also reads ward granted to other permanents.

static:basic-land-type-mana.description: Rules 305.6 and 305.7: a land with a basic land type has that type's intrinsic mana ability, including a type it gained.

static:cant-be-sacrificed.description: A per-object 'can't be sacrificed' that edicts, sacrifice costs and effects respect.

static:combat-damage-by-toughness.description: Statics under which creatures assign combat damage equal to their toughness rather than their power, read wherever combat damage is sized (standard assignment, the assign-combat-damage offer, trample, unblocked damage, bot combat math), plus 'can attack as though it didn't have defender'.

static:combat-restriction-extensions.description: More combat restrictions: one-shot 'can't block this turn' (on a creature, or as a turn-wide rule), 'can't be blocked by [filter]' and 'can block only [filter]', must be blocked if able (at least one blocker), can't attack its owner, and attack only the nearest opponent in a chosen direction.

static:counters-persist-across-zones.description: Let a card keep its counters when it changes zones, instead of moveObject always clearing them.

static:enters-replacement-for-others.description: Enters-battlefield replacements applied to other permanents: opponents' matching permanents enter tapped, and other creatures you control enter with N extra +1/+1 counters, with N read when they enter.

static:gain-abilities-from-graveyard.description: The Necrotic Ooze shape: the source has the activated abilities (mana abilities included) of every matching card in graveyards.

static:grant-abilities-to-spells.description: Statics and turn-scoped effects that grant keywords or abilities to spells you cast (cascade, split second, lifelink, deathtouch), read on the stack and at cast time. dealDamage honours a spell's granted keywords.

static:grant-to-cards-outside-battlefiel.description: Statics that grant abilities to cards outside the battlefield: ninjutsu, miracle, warp, web-slinging or an alternative cost to matching cards in hand or spells you cast, and flashback or escape to matching cards in your graveyard.

static:grant-types-to-others.description: Layer-4 statics that add types or subtypes to other permanents. effectiveTypes and effectiveSubtypes, matchesFilter and staticAffects then have to read external grants.

static:legend-rule-exemptions.description: Ways out of the legend rule: a static that turns it off for its controller's permanents, and 'isn't legendary if it's a token'.

static:mana-pool-reads.description: Conditions and P/T bonuses that read the controller's unspent mana pool live ('N or more unspent mana', '+1/+1 for each unspent {G}'). The computed cache must be invalidated whenever the pool changes.

static:max-hand-size.description: Statics that set a maximum hand size, for the controller ('eleven') or for opponents, read in the cleanup discard.

static:pt-per-amount.description: grantPtPerCount counts things other than battlefield permanents: counters on the affected object itself, and cards in exile.

static:self-type-changes.description: Conditional layer-4 changes to a permanent's own types: remove a card type ('isn't a creature' unless devotion is high enough), and add types while it's off the battlefield ('as long as it isn't on the battlefield, it's a 1/1 Insect creature').

static:set-base-pt-others.description: Layer-7b base P/T sets on other permanents: a static that sets base P/T or base toughness only, and one-shot mass effects over a filter that animate every match or set its base P/T until end of turn.

static:trigger-count-modifiers.description: More causes for the trigger doubler: a cast or a copy, damage dealt to your creatures, a source of power 2 or less, a creature type, a source and its Equipment. Built so far: doubleTriggers over entering, attacking and combat damage to a player, and suppressEntryTriggers (Elesh Norn, Torpor Orb).

trigger:activates-ability.description: A 'whenever a player activates an ability' trigger with filters, for example '{X} in its activation cost'.

trigger:becomes-target-fixes.description: The becomes-target trigger gets a spell-only flag, and object-targeted is emitted once per object, not once per target slot.

trigger:bends.description: A 'whenever you waterbend, earthbend, firebend, or airbend' trigger, plus a per-turn record of which bending kinds a player has done ('if you've done all four this turn').

trigger:cards-exiled-batch.description: A batched 'one or more cards are put into exile from graveyards and/or the battlefield' trigger.

trigger:cast-or-play-origin-zone.description: Record the zone a spell was cast from, or a land played from, on the spell-cast and land-played events. Cast triggers can then filter on 'from your hand', 'not from your hand' or 'from exile', and 'play a card from exile' includes lands.

trigger:cast-spell-clauses.description: Cast-trigger clauses: modal spells only, with the number of modes chosen as the trigger value, and 'shares no creature type with your creatures or creature cards in your graveyard'.

trigger:combat-damage-batch.description: Batched 'one or more creatures [you control / matching a filter] deal combat damage to a player / to your opponents'. It fires once per damaged player per combat-damage sub-pass, with the batch available.

trigger:combat-trigger-extensions.description: Combat-trigger vocabulary: 'becomes blocked', 'whenever a player attacks one of your opponents', otherOnly on the attacks and combat-damage triggers, and the trigger object set for blocker-declared and combat damage-dealt events.

trigger:commit-crime.description: Crimes: targeting an opponent, their permanents or their graveyard cards with a spell, ability or trigger commits a crime, and 'whenever you commit a crime' triggers on it.

trigger:copies-spell.description: A trigger on the spell-copied event ('whenever you copy an instant or sorcery spell', magecraft's 'or copy').

trigger:counters-put.description: A 'whenever one or more counters are put on [filter]' trigger that supplies the amount.

trigger:damage-trigger-extensions.description: Damage-trigger vocabulary: source-side triggers (deals damage to a creature, a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, a spell deals damage to its own target), a filter on dealt-damage, and damage whose source is the trigger object ('it deals damage').

trigger:destroyed.description: An 'is destroyed' trigger, distinct from dies (a sacrifice or an SBA isn't a destroy).

trigger:discards-extensions.description: The discards trigger gains a card filter, can fire once per card with a trigger object, can supply the count as a trigger value, and records the cause (an opponent's spell or ability) for cards that trigger from the graveyard.

trigger:enters-batch.description: 'Whenever one or more other creatures you control enter': fires once per simultaneous group of entries.

trigger:leaves-battlefield-filter.description: The leaves-battlefield trigger gains a filter and otherOnly (checked against last-known info), and narrowing by destination zone.

trigger:leaves-graveyard.description: A batched 'one or more cards leave your graveyard' trigger, once per simultaneous move.

trigger:life-change-amount.description: The loses-life and gains-life triggers supply the amount lost or gained as the trigger value, so 'you draw that many cards' can read it.

trigger:nth-each-turn.description: The Nth card you draw each turn. Built so far: nthEachTurn on cast-spell triggers (your first matching spell each turn, your second spell each turn).

trigger:opponents-lose-exactly-n-life.description: A batched 'one or more opponents each lose exactly N life' trigger, grouping life loss by simultaneous event.

trigger:plays-land.description: A 'whenever you play a land' trigger, distinct from a land entering.

trigger:put-into-graveyard.description: Batched 'one or more [filter] cards are put into your graveyard' triggers: from anywhere (dies, mill, discard, countered spell), and from your library specifically.

trigger:sacrifice-filter.description: The sacrifice trigger takes a filter ('nontoken', a type), and permanent-sacrificed sets the trigger object.

trigger:saga-final-chapter.description: An event when a chapter ability resolves, carrying whether it was the final chapter, and a trigger on it.

trigger:surveils.description: A 'whenever you surveil' trigger off the existing scried/surveil event.

trigger:you-tap-opponent-creature.description: permanent-tapped records who did the tapping, backing 'whenever you tap an untapped creature an opponent controls'.

zone:activated-ability-zones.description: Activated abilities from other zones: from the command zone (legalActions offers them), and a graveyard ability that doesn't exile its own source.

zone:cast-cards-you-dont-own.description: Casting a card you don't own (from an opponent's hand or from exile) makes the caster control the spell and the permanent it becomes. Today moveObject resets controller to owner. Add owner-relative cost modification ('spells you cast but don't own') and a turn-scoped permission to cast from an opponent's hand.

zone:cast-from-library-top.description: A static permission to cast matching spells from the top of your library. It needs a new cast zone in castSpell, whyCannotCast and legalActions, plus the top card revealed.

zone:graveyard-cast-permissions.description: Permissions that reach any player's graveyard (Coram), and a one-shot permission to *play* a target card (lands included) rather than only cast it. Built so far: the one-shot 'you may cast target card from your graveyard this turn' on the card (Silas Renn, Emry; lost if the card leaves the graveyard, lapses at end of turn), Muldrotha's per-permanent-type allowances (a land played with the land drop, a multi-typed card spending one chosen type), a permission with an extra life cost (payLife), and a choice of grantor when several apply (LegalAction/cast-spell graveyardGrant).

zone:impulse-permission-options.description: Options on impulse (play-from-exile) permissions: cast without paying the mana cost, a CardFilter for which cards may be cast, and new durations (until your next end step, for as long as it remains exiled).

zone:play-from-exile-with-counter.description: A static permission to play lands and cast spells from exile, limited to cards with a given counter (stash, fetch) or cards you exiled, optionally only on your turn.

zone:visibility-extensions.description: Who can see what, in viewFor and revealedThisTurn: a card exiled face down that only the exiler may look at, 'plays with their hand revealed', 'look at the top card of your library any time' (owner only), and effects that reveal cards to every player (look-and-choose's 'reveal', 'you may reveal that card').

decision:trigger-order.description: The controller orders their own simultaneous triggers going on the stack (rule 603.3b). Today the engine picks an order for them, which decides the outcome whenever two copies of an entry trigger interact (Yarok doubling a fetch, Tifa Lockhart's two halves).

keyword:affinity.description: Affinity for a card type or filter (rule 702.41): the spell costs {1} less for each matching permanent. A cost reduction that scales with a count already exists; this is the printed keyword, which also has to be grantable to other spells.
